title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision
description:
All Elite Wrestling is back in the Bluegrass State!

AEW Collision returns to Truist Arena in Highland Heights on Saturday, October 3, bringing the best in professional wrestling back to Truist Arena for the first time in two years!

Don’t miss your chance to see AEW’s biggest stars LIVE as they bring hard-hitting matches, unforgettable moments and non-stop action to Truist Arena. Where the best wrestle — and where you can see it all live!

Join us for this LIVE event at Truist Arena in Highland Heights.

AEW Collision is a two-hour, in-ring wrestling spectacular featuring more wrestlers, more stories and more action for AEW fans.

AEW Collision airs every Saturday at 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT on TNT and streams live on HBO Max.

Don’t miss AEW Collision LIVE at Truist Arena on Saturday, October 3!

Tickets $34-$96.

title: Alabama
description:
Alabama, The Oak Ridge Boys

The iconic Country Music Hall of Fame group ALABAMA is bringing their critically acclaimed Live in Concert tour to Truist Arena in Highland Heights, KY on October 11th at 7:00 PM. Presented by Outback Presents and Pepper Entertainment, Alabama will be supported by The Oak Ridge Boys.

With over 33 No. 1 singles on the Billboard Hot Country Songs chart and timeless classics like “Mountain Music,” “Song of the South,” “Dixieland Delight,” and “The Closer You Get,” ALABAMA continues to delight audiences nationwide. The band earned CMA’s Entertainer of the Year three years in a row (1982–1984) and was inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 2005. They have won over 200 industry awards and still counting. They’ve earned 21 Gold®, Platinum® and Multi-Platinum® albums and were named the RIAA's Country Group of the Century. They are members of the Country Music Hall of Fame and have a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. They are also world-class philanthropists who have raised over 800 million dollars for charity.
